title: TriCoast Worldwide & Vitagraph Set Fall Release For Malcolm McDowell & James Paxton Western ‘Last Train To Fortune’
text:
EXCLUSIVE: TriCoast Worldwide and Vitagraph Films have set a theatrical release for the Brad Wyman produced, Adam Rifkin directed western comedy Last Train to Fortune .

Last Train to Fortune will pulled into New York on Sept. 18, followed by Dallas on Sept. 23, and Los Angeles on Sept. 25, with plans to expand the theatrical rollout to additional markets throughout the fall.

Last Train to Fortune stars Malcolm McDowell, the late Bill Paxton’s son James Paxton, Mary Steenburgen, Bernadette Peters and Laura Marano. The pic was written by Michelle Rifkin, the director’s mother. Related Stories News Adam Rifkin Hops On Stoner Comedy 'Toad' With James Paxton News Malcolm McDowell, Mary Steenburgen, Bernadette Peters & James Paxton Board Adam Rifkin's 'Last Train To Fortune'

The release will also include Malcolm McDowell retrospective screenings at select theatres, including at NYC’s Cinema 1, 2, 3 where A Clockwork Orange originally premiered. The NYC engagement (September 17–20) at Village East by Angelika will feature opening weekend appearances by members of the cast and filmmakers, with additional events planned for Dallas and Los Angeles. Watch on Deadline

TriCoast will handle the film’s streaming distribution later this year.

Pic is produced by Brad Wyman, Michael P.J. Gerstein, and Adam Rifkin.

Set against the backdrop of the American frontier, Last Train to Fortune follows uptight, schoolteacher Cecil Peachtree (McDowell) and fearsome, outlaw Jedidiah Dooley (Paxton), two unlikely companions who embark on a perilous journey to the town of Fortune, where Peachtree has been hired as the new Schoolmaster.

“Although Last Train to Fortune is set in the 1870s, its message could not be more urgent or relevant today. At a time when books are being banned across the country and education itself is increasingly under attack, the film reaffirms a timeless truth; education sets us free,” says director Adam Rifkin.

Last Train to Fortune was written by Michele Rifkin, 37 years ago, and was intended to star the late Bill Paxton in the role of Dooley opposite McDowell. Frequent McDowell collaborator Lindsay Anderson was set to direct, who passed away before production began. Cut to 2017, Adam Rifkin, Wyman, McDowell and Paxton were about to try again. But just as pre-production was slated to begin, Paxton died unexpectedly. In the years that followed, Rifkin, Wyman and McDowell grew closer to Bill’s actor son James. Everyone decided that it was time for the movie to be made with Twisters actor James stepping in for his father.

Said Paxton, “For me, Last Train to Fortune is a film I felt compelled to bring to life from the moment director Adam Rifkin and producer Brad Wyman first approached me about it nine years ago. The script instantly transported me to the Old West and into the unlikely, destined bond between Jedidiah Dooley and Cecil Peachtree. Beyond its emotional weight, the film carries a powerful, timely message—a tribute to great mentors, the value of reading, and the importance of education at a moment when books are being banned and learning is under attack. I couldn’t be prouder to share this beautiful and resonant story with the world.”

Worldwide rights outside the initial theatrical release—including VOD, digital, home entertainment, and international distribution—are being handled by TriCoast Worldwide.

title: ‘Run Hide Fight: Infidels’: Full Trailer For Jonathan Majors’ Controversial Comeback Movie, Daily Wire Release Date Revealed
text:
EXCLUSIVE : Here is your first full trailer for Jonathan Majors ‘ comeback movie, Run Hide Fight: Infidels , a sequel of sorts to The Daily Wire ‘s 2020 movie Run Hide Fight .

The film sparked a level of controversy online five weeks ago when its provocative logline was revealed as follows:

“When radical Islamic terrorists hijack a liberal college’s pro-Palestine encampment to enforce barbaric Sharia law on students and execute infidels in a makeshift caliphate, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard tired of ‘Uncle Tom’ smears, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers and keep America from surrendering to the enemy on its own soil.” Related Stories News Montana Locals Protest Daily Wire's Pro-ICE Production As Filming Disrupts Businesses With Apparent Dramatization Of Renée Good Shooting Casting Jonathan Majors Set For 'Dinner At Nick's' - Cannes

As we first revealed in February of this year, the film is in the vein of ’80s and ’90s action movies Red Dawn and Toy Soldiers , which were both about groups of teenage boys who had to band together to defeat invading enemies. Run Hide Fight filmmaker Kyle Rankin returns as writer-director. Release date on the Daily Wire platform is newly scheduled for September 16th. Watch on Deadline

This one, true to Daily Wire’s politics, seemingly comes with a particularly blunt political message. It’s a message that has stirred up a level of censure online with one critic in the LA Times labelling the premise and previous teaser “xenophobic and Islamophobic” and “rehashing 40-year-old tropes while invoking conspiracy theories of Muslims bringing sharia law to America, because outrage is cheap to produce and easy to monetize”.

Controversy hasn’t been far from the project since we revealed it. Not only does it mark the comeback for Majors, who has been shunned by major studios since a domestic violence case, but the production itself also saw a labor strike and safety concerns following an on-set accident where Majors and co-star JC Kilcoyne fell through an unsecured window.

Ben Shapiro ( The Ben Shapiro Show ) and Dallas Sonnier ( Bone Tomahawk ) are producing for The Daily Wire and Bonfire Legend, respectively. Travis Mills ( Frontier Crucible ), Lillian Campbell ( The Pendragon Cycle ), and Sydney Aucreman ( Terror On The Prairie ) are also producing.

Majors’ career was motoring following roles in movies such as The Last Black Man in San Francisco , Creed III , Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania and Magazine Dreams , as well as series such as HBO horror Lovecraft Country , but he was dropped from numerous projects when found guilty in 2023 of assaulting his former girlfriend. title: Olivia Wilde Talks Fight To Get ‘The Invite’ A Theatrical Release Following Sundance Response: “I Was Passionate About It With A Lot Of Support”
text:
Olivia Wilde has revealed that she was “passionate” about getting a theatrical release for The Invite following the audience response to the comedy at Sundance.

“I wanted to investigate this phenomenon that we found at Sundance when we felt the film have that chemical reaction with the audience the first time and it was extraordinary,” she told a press conference at the Locarno Film Festival where the film screens on the Piazza Grande this evening.

“I thought, well, this was magic. We have to listen to this… we have to fight for it,” she continued. “If you don’t fight for it, listen, you know this…  they bribe you to not take theatrical. It’s a bribe. You get paid more. Not me, not the filmmaker. The financiers will get a lot more money to go to streaming, and you can take that bribe and give that up if that’s where your priorities lie.” Related Stories News Chris Rock's A24 Pic 'Misty Green' To Stream On Netflix In Early November News Former A24 Docs Chief Joins 'Oasis: Don't Look Back In Anger' Outfit Magna Studios

Wilde thanked producer Megan Ellison at Annapurna for getting on board with her desire to get the film into cinemas, and agreeing to accept A24 ‘s theatrical offer, hinting that the streamers had gone higher. She also credited FilmNation Entertainment , which co-handled the domestic sale with UTA, for securing individual theatrical distributors internationally. Watch on Deadline

Olivia Wilde Talks Fight To Get 'The Invite' A Theatrical Release Following Positive Sundance Audience Response: "They bribe you to not take theatrical. It's a bribe. You get paid more… and you can take that bribe and give that up if that's where your priorities lie.” pic.twitter.com/qfVXofMEjg

“But we were really lucky that our financier gave me the opportunity to make this decision, which is something I don’t take lightly. She could have very easily said, no, we’re going to go with the much bigger offer. But I know that she, too, felt this incredible reaction that had happened at Sundance and that it was something worth investing in.”

Beyond the audience reaction in Sundance, Wilde questioned the fact that comedy as a genre had come disconnected from cinema audiences.

“I really feel that there’s no genre that benefits from the communal experience more than comedy… it’s an ancient part of our culture. As humans, we’ve gathered and told stories and laughed together for thousands of years in different forms, in different ways.

“I felt that comedies had been relegated to kind of second tier that didn’t deserve theaters. And the first place we confronted that was really in production… When it came to shooting it on film, I was very passionate about shooting it on 35 millimeter. I hadn’t been able to do that yet. And I thought this is the one I’m gonna really fight for.”

Wilde was speaking ahead of a sold-out screening of the film on Locarno’s 8,000 capacity Piazza Grande on Saturday evening.

“Today’s very special for me and all of us because I was hoping we would all be seen a few theaters maybe a couple of hundred people in a theater and tonight we’re going to watch it with 8,000 people. I actually can’t believe it. I am in shock.”

Since opening on June 26 in the U.S., The Invit e has grossed $23.5 million domestically, and added another $18 million globally across some 30 international territories. Ascot Elite will begin the film’s Swiss rollout on August 13.

title: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek Memoir ‘Behind The Castle Walls’ Gets Fall Release Date
text:
Gallery Books, a division of Simon & Schuster, has set a September 29 publication date for Behind the Castle Walls: My Thirty Years at the Happiest Place on Earth by Bob Chapek , the short-tenured former CEO of Disney .

The memoir chronicles Chapek’s 30-year tenure at the company and “the high-stakes maneuverings that unraveled behind the scenes” from his 2020 appointment as chief executive to his dismissal in 2022 , the publisher revealed Wednesday. It will be the first time he’s publicly addressed the corporate drama.

Chapek recounts his early years, raised in small-town Indiana by his mother and WWII veteran father. After graduating from Indiana University, he earned an MBA from Michigan State before landing jobs at J. Walter Thompson and the H.J. Heinz Company. Watch on Deadline

He began is career at Disney in 1993 as marketing director for Home Entertainment, going on to key roles including president of Consumer Products and chairman of Parks, Experiences and Products. In February 2020, he was named CEO when Bob Iger abruptly stepped down just as the Covid pandemic took hold, shuttering theme parks, theaters and cruise ships.

RELATED: Disney Names Joss Hastings Consumer Products Marketing Chief As Division Moves Under Studios

“The stakes were high, the decisions unforgiving nd the backlash often inordinate, leaving him to wonder whether he had become the scapegoat in it all. In 2022, Chapek was out; his former boss was back in,” the publisher’s blurb says.

“Four years later, after reflection and distance, Chapek is going behind the scenes of one of the world’s most recognizable — and reticent — companies on Earth. Behind the Castle Walls is a revealing and thrilling story of ambition, power and the price of Disney magic.”

Chapek was little known outside of Disney and it was a surprise when Iger handpicked the exec to take the reins. He was soon being pilloried on several fronts including management decisions that alienated key executives, and a public fight with star Scarlett Johansson. His response to legislation (dubbed the ‘Don’t Say Gay’ bill) in Florida angered both company employees and Gov. Ron DeSantis.

His apparent rubber stamp by the Disney board was used as ammunition by activist investor Nelson Peltz in a bruising proxy fight with the Mouse House. Iger — who just acquired the Los Angeles Lakers — exited earlier this year with another former Parks chief, Josh D’Amaro, now at the helm after a lengthy search process overseen by chairman James Gorman.

However, it’s no secret that Chapek’s tenure was complicated by an unusual arrangement that saw Iger stay on as executive chairman, retaining control over creative endeavors at the company and leaving Chapek feeling undermined from the start. Now he tells his side.

title: ‘First They Came For My College,’ Film About Ron DeSantis-Led “Hostile Takeover” Of Florida School, Announces Theatrical Run
text:
EXCLUSIVE: Fourth Act Films has set the theatrical release for First They Came For My College , a documentary about a right-wing “coup” at a Florida liberal arts school orchestrated by Republican Gov. Ron DeSantis.

The film directed and produced by Patrick Bresnan will open Sept. 17 at the Hippodrome in Gainesville, FL and on Sept. 25 at the DCTV Firehouse Cinema in New York City. It will hit theaters in over 30 markets total, including Los Angeles, San Francisco, Houston, Austin, TX, St. Petersburg, FL, Sarasota, FL, Lawrence, KS, Columbus, OH, and Springfield, MO. Related Stories News How TIFFCOM Is Building On Cannes Recognition To Strengthen Global Networks, Co-production & Japanese IP Festivals Tokyo Film Festival Chiefs Talk Balancing Blockbusters & Arthouse; Launching International Films In Japan

“ First They Came For My College tells the inside story of the right-wing campaign to ‘reconquer’ higher education in America,” notes a release. “ New College of Florida was the first public college to be transformed by a political coup—a blueprint for our new era of unprecedented censorship and political interference in academia. By embedding with the student newspaper, an outspoken professor, and students from all sides of the political spectrum, this verité feature reveals a microcosm of America’s culture wars and serves as an essential document for students today grappling with their moment in history.” Watch on Deadline

Gov. DeSantis began the takeover in 2023 by appointing “six ultraconservatives to the school’s Board of Trustees, including Christopher Rufo, the right-wing activist behind attacks on Critical Race Theory, and Matthew Spalding, who would go on to play a leading role in Project 2025.”

The documentary, which premiered at True/False in Columbia, MO, shows how faculty and students mounted “a fierce resistance, exposing what they see as the new administration’s cruelty, incompetence, and corruption.”

In a statement, director-producer Patrick Bresnan said, “For me, we will hopefully look back on First They Came For My College like we do on civil rights-era films or Vietnam-era films and we say, ‘I can’t believe that’s who we were. I can’t believe that’s what we did to our greatest professors. I can’t believe that’s what we did to college students.’ What kept me going is the need to finish this document so that we can remember this period and so it doesn’t happen again.”

Along with Bresnan, First They Came For My College is produced by Holly Herrick, Harry William Hanbury, and Zackary Drucker.

“As alumni of New College, we couldn’t look away when we heard about the state of Florida’s plans for an ideological remaking of the school,” commented Herrick and Hanbury. “New College’s academic environment changed our lives, and we wanted to understand what it would mean for students experiencing that same transformation to have their education interrupted by a staged battle in America’s culture wars: one that targeted LGBTQ+ students and the ideals of diversity, equity, and inclusion, and tried—unsuccessfully—to silence dissent. In sharing this story around the country, we hope to inspire others to defend and support the freedom to learn and the freedom to be who you are.”

The documentary features several New College students, including Gabriella Batista. “At New College, we had a culture of radical acceptance, where people could live authentically,” Batista said. “And that’s what the people who took over the school tried to stamp out. But we doubled down, resisted relentlessly, took care of each other, and found joy in community. Now it’s up to all of us who lived through that ordeal to warn other schools of what’s coming and show how to stand up to right-wing bullies.”

The film’s executive producers are Ross Boucher, Steve Phillips, Margaret Brown, and Kim A. Snyder. Patrick Bresnan serves as the director of photography along with Sara Kinney. Leah Marino and Ivete Lucas edited the film. Music is by Michael Montes.

Oscar winner Steven Bognar, and Primetime Emmy winners Jesse Moss and Amanda McBaine serve as consulting producers along with co-producers Monique Walton, Heather Courtney, and Daniel Raphael Potthast.

Bresnan and other members of the film team participated in a Q&A after the world premiere at True/False. He explained why he poured his creative energies into First They Came For My College .

“I fell in love with the students. I fell in love with the teachers,” Bresnan said. “And we had made a film in Florida [ Pahokee ] about a senior high school in a super-segregated rural farming village. And I just felt like this was the sequel to that film and I needed to be there. So that’s how it happened.”

title: ‘Star Wars: Mandalorian & Grogu’ To Stream On Disney+ At End Of Summer
text:
Disney has set a September 2 global streaming date for Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu on Disney+ . That reps a long 103-day window between theatrical and streaming for the Jon Favreau-directed movie.

The movie led the Memorial Day box office with a $167 million global start but wound up being the lowest-grossing live-action Star Wars movie ever with a final worldwide tally of $345M. Its production cost before P&A was $165M.

The IP was hatched on Disney+ over three seasons with myriad spinoffs, such as the live-action Ahsoka series and The Book of Boba Fett. Moviegoers essentially didn’t want to go out of their way to see a streaming property on the big screen, particularly one sans heat at 60% fresh with critics and 86% with audiences.

Mandalorian and Grogu was co-written by Favreau, Noah Kloor and Lucasfilm co-boss Dave Filoni. Ian Bryce, Kathleen Kennedy, Favreau and Filoni produced the movie, which stars Pedro Pascal, Sigourney Weaver, David Allen White and Martin Scorsese. Watch on Deadline

title: Pixar New Pic ‘Ghost Market’ About Hungry Apparitions, Hits Theaters In 2028 – D23

title: Disney’s ‘The Greatest Showman’ Musical Sets Spring 2027 West End Opening, Principal Cast – D23
text:
The Greatest Showman , the Disney Theatrical Group musical stage adaptation of the 2017 film, will premiere in London’s West End at Theatre Royal Drury Lane in Spring 2027, Disney announced at the D23 event in Anaheim last night.

Also revealed was the cast: The Greatest Showman will star Oliver Tompsett as P.T. Barnum, Samantha Barks as Charity Barnum, Ben Joyce as Phillip Carlyle, Vajèn van den Bosch as Jenny Lind and Malinda Parris as Lettie Lutz. Further casting is to be announced.

The musical had a sold-out, pre-West End run at The Bristol Hippodrome earlier this year. Deadline first reported last year that the project was headed to the West End with an eye toward Broadway. Disney has not disclosed plans for the latter.

The stage adaptation features songs by Benj Pasek and Justin Paul ( La La Land, Dear Evan Hansen ), a book by Tim Federle ( High School Musical: The Musical: The Series ), and direction and choreography by Casey Nicholaw ( Mean Girls, The Prom ). Watch on Deadline

RELATED: Deadline’s Full Coverage Of Disney’s D23 Fan Event

Based on the 20th Century Studios motion picture with story by Jenny Bicks, The Greatest Showman is the first 20th Century Studios (formerly 20th Century Fox) title to be adapted for the stage by Disney Theatrical Group. The Seelig Group, a producer of the original film, is also a producer of the musical.

The synopsis: Inspired by the life of famed showman P.T. Barnum, the story follows Barnum as he sets out to create a spectacular new form of entertainment, assembling a troupe of performers and outsiders who become an unlikely family.

The musical will feature the Grammy Award-winning and Academy Award-nominated songs by EGOT winners Pasek and Paul , including “The Greatest Show,” “A Million Dreams,” “Come Alive,” “Rewrite the Stars,” “Never Enough” and the Globe-winning “This Is Me,” together with new songs written especially for the musical.

Calling the musical “open-hearted, exuberant and unapologetically joyous,” Anne Quart and Andrew Flatt of Disney Theatrical Group said in a statement, “The show is born of a collaboration with an incredible group of artists. Benj Pasek and Justin Paul return with the songs audiences will know and love, alongside exhilarating new numbers created especially for the stage; Tim Federle’s book captures a heartfelt love of theatre and show business; and two-time Tony Award-winning Casey Nicholaw directs an extraordinary cast led by the incomparable Oliver Tompsett and Samantha Barks.”

In the central role of legendary carnival huckster P.T. Barnum is Tompsett, whose stage credits include A Knight’s Tale, & Juliet in both Broadway and London, Pretty Woman, Kinky Boots, The World Goes Round, Rock of Ages and others. Film credits include Show Dogs and The Hard Way.

Barks has appeared in Les Misérables, Frozen, Chess, The Last Five Years , among others, and was one of the participants on the BBC series I’d Do Anything and won the 2025 series of The Masked Singer. Film credits include Tomorrow Morning, For Love or Money, Bitter Harvest and Les Misérables.

Joyce’s theater work includes The Hunchback of Notre Dame, Back to the Future and Jersey Boys. Television work includes The Power.

Van den Bosch appeared in Disney’s Frozen , Mary Poppins and Tarzan as well as Les Misérables, Kinky Boots, Grease and The Sound of Music . She received the Nickelodeon Kids’ Choice Award for ‘Favourite TV Star’ in 2017 and film work includes Eb, Bledders, Onze Jongens 3 and First Kiss .

Parris’ theater credits include Hadestown, Hercules, & Juliet and others, with film credits including Wicked and Everybody’s Talking About Jamie .

The creative team includes Alex Lacamoire (Music Supervision, Incidental & Dance Music Arrangements and Orchestrations), David Korins (Scenic Design), Gregg Barnes and Sky Switser (Costume Design); Natasha Katz (Lighting Design); Peter Hylenski (Sound Design), George Reeve (Video Design), Lorenzo Pisoni (Circus Creation & Design), Josh Marquette (Hair & Wig Design), Milagros Medina-Cerdeira (Make-Up Design), Jeremy Chernick (Special Effects Design), and Skylar Fox (Illusions Design). Justin Paul is also providing Vocal and Incidental Music Arrangements.

In the film, the characters announced today were played by Hugh Jackman, Michelle Williams, Zac Efron, Rebecca Ferguson and Keala Settle.

title: Roger Avary’s ‘Paradise Lost’ & Alex Proyas’ ‘Heaven’ Have U.S. Theatrical Commitments As AI Outfit Ex Machina Strikes Cinema Deal On Slate
text:
EXCLUSIVE : Ex Machina Studios has struck an exclusive North American theatrical distribution agreement with Mayfair Media Group, a group of exhibition executives led by Galaxy Theatres duo Frank Rimkus and Rafe Cohen.

The deal will see a number of Ex Machina’s movies released in New York, LA, Chicago, Dallas, Toronto, Atlanta, Miami, San Francisco, and other key metropolitan areas. Mayfair is due to give the films wide releases (1500+ screens) via Galaxy theaters as well as other theater chains, which we’re told were secured after they were shown footage of upcoming projects. Related Stories News AI Sci-Fi Series 'Kira' Heads To MIPCOM For Ex Machina & K5, First Look Images News Roger Avary To Adapt & Direct Biblical Epic 'Paradise Lost' For AI-Oriented Producer Ex Machina Studios -- Cannes Market

AI-oriented production outfit Ex Machina plans to release four projects in 2027, followed by approximately six films annually under its exclusive engagement with Mayfair. The deal marks the first time an AI-oriented producer-studio has secured a theatrical pipeline deal such as this. Watch on Deadline

First up are Roger Avary ‘s Paradise Lost , which is scheduled for Easter 2027, and Alex Proyas’ Heaven in summer 2027. We told you about both projects earlier this year. Both projects are currently casting and we’re told both should enter production soon.

Heaven is an original screenplay by Proyas. The story centers on “a desperate bureaucrat who decides to escape his failing life by entering a technologically perfected afterlife — only to discover that paradise is a carefully constructed illusion with terrifying consequences.” You can read more about it here .

Pulp Fiction writer Avary’s Paradise Lost is based on the John Milton poem of 1667 and is “the ultimate faith-based heroic saga: a cosmic war in the heavens where the charismatic, rebellious archangel Lucifer defies God, is hurled into the abyss of Hell, and vows revenge on all creation. From the fiery lake of damnation, Lucifer rises as Satan to seduce humanity’s first parents, Adam and Eve, in the flawless Garden of Eden, triggering the Fall of Man and the loss of Paradise itself.” You can read more about it here .

Both have been in the works with other studios for some time but couldn’t get off the ground due to financial constraints. The teams are hoping that AI will help make the world-building elements possible. Ex Machina co-founder and CEO Marco Weber ( Igby Goes Down ) is producing Paradise Lost , with veteran production designer Kirk Petruccelli ( Lara Croft: Tomb Raider ) executive-producing.

Rimkus, who also serves as Chairman for the Board of National Association of Theatre Owners of California/Nevada, and Cohen will lead a group of execs under the Mayfair Media Group banner including veteran marketing executive John Hegeman, who has worked at Orion Pictures, Blumhouse Tilt, Lionsgate, Artisan Entertainment, and Fox Atomic, and Scott Kennedy, founder of Falling Forward Films.

As previously reported, Ex Machina established an international sales operation through its partnership with Daniel Baur’s K5 International.

Beyond its own slate, Ex Machina says it plans to pursue select third-party acquisitions and service agreements as it expands its theatrical distribution platform.

“We’re excited to partner with Ex Machina Studios as they bring a fresh and innovative approach to the art of filmmaking,” said Mayfair Media Group’s Rimkus. “Their commitment to combining emerging technologies with exceptional storytelling and world-class filmmakers has the potential to redefine what’s possible in independent cinema. We’re proud to help bring these remarkable films to audiences across North America.”

“Marco and the Ex Machina team are creating an amazing and diverse slate of epic theatrical adventures,” added Hegeman. “Frank and I are really excited about bringing these films to audiences in theaters across the country. I think people are going to be blown away by what they see.”

“The idea behind Ex Machina Studios, from the beginning, was to take advantage of rapidly evolving technologies while working with outstanding filmmakers to realize their vision and create original IP without traditional budgetary restrictions or green-light committees,” added Ex Machina’s Marco Weber. “By building our theatrical distribution platform with Frank and the Mayfair team, we can now bring these films directly to audiences in theatres. It’s the next step in building Ex Machina into a destination for forward-thinking filmmakers—giving them greater control of their vision while connecting their work with the audiences it was created for.”

“Stonecutter Media is in the business of distributing and promoting edgy, over-the-top films, and Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence fits right in our wheelhouse,” said Steven Karel, owner and president of Stonecutter Media. “These types of films have proven time and time again to have a sales edge that you don’t get with softer movies.”

Said Starboard founder Thomas Zambeck: “Steve and I have known each other for years, and we always believed we would eventually find the right project to work on together. Stonecutter understands how to reach the audience for a film like this, and this partnership gives us an opportunity to build something that extends well beyond a single release.”

title: Fast & Furious Ride Opening Date Finally Set At Universal Studios Hollywood
text:
After a summer of clamor by fans waiting for the new, groundbreaking Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift coaster to open, Universal Studios Hollywood has finally set a date.

The ride got its own Super Bowl commercial earlier this year where it was revealed that fans would be able to rocket along at 72 mph in “Summer 2026.” Then came noise complaints from neighbors about the innovative coaster, which stretches down a terraced hillside on the steep Universal Studios lot.

Park officials addressed those issues by installing transparent sound-reduction barriers along portions of the ride. Now, after months of anticipation , Universal Studios Hollywood is set to make good on that “Summer 2026” promise — just under the wire. Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift will open on September 16, less than a week before the start of fall. It will, by all accounts, be worth the wait.

Set in a superbly-themed warehouse garage reminiscent of the films, the already well-tested Hollywood Drift rockets riders along 4,100 feet of elaborate aerial track while they drift at up to 360-degrees in individually-themed ride vehicles at forces of up to 3.6 Gs. See video of the ride being tested here .

See more of it in the new TV spot announcing the opening date below.

Riders will be strapped into one of four iconic Fast Saga ride vehicles: Dom Toretto’s the Dodge Charger, Mazda RX-7, Nissan Skyline GT-R and Brian O’Conner’s Toyota Supra — each modeled after the cars driven by favorite Fast characters in the film series.

The arrival platform will be anchored by an original, giant mural created by artist Tristan Eaton which depicts the final street racing action scene in the very first Fast film, 2001’s The Fast and the Furious . The mural portrays the aerial-bound Dodge Charger and Toyota Supra vehicles racing against a speeding train.

The pre-ride theming includes other elements to keep guests entertained while in line. The environment is filled with recreated props from the Fast Saga films. Displays will feature QR codes that open up additional behind‑the‑scenes insights and context about the displays. Those codes are powered Universal Studios’ fan engagement site, the Backlot Club.

Highlights of the props include:

o Car Cannon, featuring the car driven by O’Conner in Fast & Furious 6

o Roll Cage and Winch, featuring the 2010 Dodge Charger SRT8, driven by Toretto, in Fast 5

o Vault Truck, as featured in Fast 5

o Motorcycle, as featured in F9 , driven by Letty Ortiz

o NOS System and Dodge Charger Engine, a recreation of the internal NOS operating system for the modified Fast & Furious ride vehicles in the films

o Ramp Car, driven by Owen Shaw in Fast & Furious 6

o Rolling Bomb, as featured in Fast X

o Rollover Stunt Rig, a recreation of the rollover stunt rigging system used in the Fast & Furious films

What’s more, a portion of the ride track will race through a transparently encased section of the queue.

Universal Orlando Resort will get its very own Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift coaster in 2027.

Universal has been going big this year in celebration of the franchise’s 25th anniversary with an event in Cannes , a starry special screening of the original film earlier this month, the announcement of a TV series, a new film and, of course, Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift.

title: Aura Entertainment Acquires Dario Russo’s ‘The Fox’ To Release Theatrically In December
text:

Following its world premiere at last year’s Adelaide Film Festival and international premiere at SXSW, The Fox went on to screen at Fantasia Festival, Melbourne International Film Festival, and Sydney Film Festival. Aura will release the film in US theaters on December 4th, following the Australian release on November 26th.

The Fox begins when a talking fox offers an affable hunter the opportunity to transform his cheating partner into the perfect woman and gets a lot more than he bargained for. The film marks Russo’s feature directorial debut. He previously wrote and directed the cult television series Danger 5 , as well as the acclaimed parody web-series, Italian Spiderman . Dario also co-created and co-wrote the upcoming animated Netflix series Dad’s House . Watch on Deadline

“Dario Russo has delivered a truly unique film with THE FOX,” said Aura Entertainment’s Marc Goldberg. “Between its wildly creative premise and exceptional cast, we were immediately drawn to the film’s originality. We’re delighted to be bringing THE FOX to US audiences and look forward to giving it a theatrical platform later this year.”

“I am super excited to bring American audiences this cautionary comedy about the dangers of talking foxes,” said Russo. “I hope this movie will prevent many people from trusting the next fox that comes to them with life advice.”

title: ‘The Rainmaker’ Sets Season 2 Release Date; Unveils Full Trailer
text:
USA Network has slotted Friday, October 16 for the Season 2 premiere of hit legal drama series The Rainmaker , inspired by John Grisham’s bestselling novel, and unveiled the full trailer.

Season two stars returning Milo Callaghan, Lana Parrilla, P.J. Byrne, Madison Iseman, Merle Dandridge, Richard Kind and Austin Nichols.

The season picks back up with Rudy Baylor (Callaghan), an underdog lawyer taking on powerful interests alongside his boss Jocelyn “Bruiser” Stone (Parrilla) and his right-hand man Deck Shifflet (Byrne), the firm’s colorful paralegal. This season, J. Lyman Stone and Associates faces old adversaries and new ones in a case where the lives of hundreds of children hang in the balance, and where winning might be just as dangerous as losing. Later, Rudy goes up against his former law school flame, Sarah Plankmore (Madison Iseman), in the courtroom at the behest of her mysterious new boss, Amanda Vonn (Dandridge), a powerful attorney whose agenda may be hiding a shocking international conspiracy. In a separate case, Bruiser’s ex-husband Tom Cassady (Nichols) turns to her for help as his legal troubles threaten his life and that of the star pitcher (Liam O’Halloran) of the minor league baseball team he coaches.

Additional cast members include Asher De Land, Libby Kay, Kevin Ryan, and Tim Murphy. John Slattery and Karen Bryson also return. Watch on Deadline

Showrunner and executive producer Michael Seitzman shared thoughts on the upcoming season in an earlier interview with Deadline. “Season 1 ended with Rudy winning a massive case. Season 2 opens with the case in appeal and Rudy suddenly famous, receiving letters and phone calls from every lost cause in the state looking for a savior, said Seitzman. “One letter arrives from a kid in juvenile detention, and it’s the one thing in the pile nobody would blame him for ignoring. But Deck sees something in it, a mystery and a puzzle to solve. Moreover, he sees it as a way for Rudy to get back to being a fighter for the underdog. The season for Rudy is about reminding himself who he really is.”

In 2025, The Rainmaker became USA Network’s most-watched freshman series in seven years and finished the year as the #1 highest-rated new scripted TV series across all of cable.

title: ‘Sunday In The Park With George’ Revival Delayed After Ariana Grande & Jonathan Bailey Exit
text:

Producer Empire Street Productions posted on Instagram that the planned 2027 release “will no longer proceed as scheduled.” It said the company “retain the rights with a view to presenting the production in 2028.”

The decision represents a U-turn after producers had initially said the show would go on following Grande’s exit. However, Deadline revealed a few weeks later that Bridgerton star Bailey was also dropping out . At the time he said his support for Grande was “unwavering.”

Grande’s high-profile Sunday in the Park exit came at the end of her arena tour and was explained by her reps as being “a much-deserved break from public facing work and appearances which has led to endless, ongoing public scrutiny.” Watch on Deadline

Deadline broke news of the Sunday in the Park London revival at the end of last year.

The Pulitzer-winning 1984 Broadway musical was inspired by the painting from French artist Georges Seurat. The plot revolves around George, a fictionalized version of Seurat, who immerses himself deeply in painting his masterpiece, and his great-grandson, a conflicted and cynical contemporary artist.

title: Bleecker Street Moves Up ‘Musk’ Doc Theatrical Release Due To Overwhelming Demand
text:
EXCLUSIVE: Bleecker Street is moving up the theatrical release of Musk – to October 9 – in response to intense interest in the documentary about the world’s richest man.

Alex Gibney ’s film, which runs 3 hours and 45 minutes with a 10-minute intermission, holds its North American premiere later Monday at the Toronto Film Festival. Its world premiere took place last week under the klieg lights of Venice, triggering a huge response. Among those weighing in – Musk himself: in an hours long rant on his X/Twitter platform (which my colleague Jake Kanter characterized as “vicious and sometimes bizarre” ), the tech mogul called Gibney a “bitter old man who lost the plot long ago” and branded him a “horrible human.” One of his posts included a graphic from the @DogeDesigner X account (closely associated with Musk) that suggested Gibney was a puppet of the Democratic Party and “team Soros” – a reference to progressive philanthropist and investor George Soros, who while very wealthy is a pauper compared to Musk.

The Musk documentary originally was set to hit theaters on October 16 but now arrives a week earlier. After the October 9 debut in New York and Los Angeles, it will expand to theaters nationwide. Watch on Deadline

RELATED: Alex Gibney Encountered “Tremendous Sense Of Fear” While Researching ‘Musk’; Praises “Brave People” Like Ashley St. Clair For Agreeing To Talk

Musk enjoys a 100 percent positive critical rating on Rotten Tomatoes. In my review posted September 8, I wrote the film “depicts the world’s richest man as petty, narcissistic, megalomaniacal, cruel, detached from humans at a personal level (including various ex-partners and many of his children) while purporting to want to save humanity by colonizing Mars. A real prince. Musk , in my view, gives Elon the takedown he richly deserves.”

The documentary paints a negative picture of Musk’s business ethics and his personal conduct. Hi first wife, Justine Musk, and one of his baby mamas, the former conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair, are among the former romantic partners of Musk who appear in the film (Justine reports Musk falsely claimed to have held their infant son Nevada in his arms as the 10-week-old died. She says Elon wasn’t there and that she held Nevada as he died).

St. Clair is at the center of the most serious concerns raised in the documentary. She reports Musk told her he would exploit “an anomaly in the matrix” to ensure Donald Trump’s election to the presidency in 2024, citing his access to “space lasers,” an apparent reference to Musk’s network of Starlink satellites. Musk denied that through a lawyer.

As Deadline’s Jake Kanter reported , “The New York Post cited a legal letter from Musk’s attorney Alex Spiro, in which the lawyer wrote: ‘You are … on notice, before release, that the insinuation is false, that the material refuting it is public, and that you chose not to be told the rest.’”

That letter does not seem to have dissuaded Bleecker Street from releasing the documentary in theaters, a debut set to happen in less than a month.

title: ‘Yaga’ Sets U.S. Release Date On AMC+; Watch Sneak Peek Ahead Of TIFF World Premiere
text:
Yaga , the upcoming contemporary mystery thriller series which reimagines the myth of Baba Yaga, is set to premiere Friday, October 23 exclusively in the U.S. on AMC+ . The series will launch with two episodes followed a new episode each Friday up to the two-episode finale on Friday, November 27. You can watch a sneak peek (which is actually a trailer) above.

Yaga will world premiere at the Toronto Film Festival on Thursday, September 17. That will be followed by a panel revealing exclusive content at New York Comic Con on Friday, October 9.

Starring Noah Reid , Hudson Williams , Clark Backo and Carrie-Anne Moss , Yaga is based on the hit play by Kat Sandler who also serves as writer, showrunner, and executive producer. Yaga reimagines the witch, who is known to live in a hut on chicken legs and potentially is a murderous seductress or powerful enchantress, depending on the author of the tale. It follows Rapp (Reid), a private investigator who arrives in the small coastal town of Whittock, to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery, Henry Park (Williams). He finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson (Backo), a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, Katherine (Moss), and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

As we reported, a previously released teaser during Comic-Con revealed a series of quick cuts of the series’ characters, especially Williams, who are caught in compromising x-rated and dangerous positions from lustful thrusts and sweaty threesomes to blood sacrifice and errant chicken feathers revealing an old, haggard witch. You can watch it below. Watch on Deadline

Additional cast includes Sheila McCarthy, Megan Follows, Ezra Franky, Patrick Gilmore, Katharine Isabelle, and Hiro Kanagawa, along with Emilija Baranac, Georgia Acken, Anisa Harris, and Sam Krochmal.

Yaga, a Crave Original series, is produced by Blink49 Studios and Front Street Pictures in association with Bell Media, with the participation of the Canada Media Fund (CMF), the Rogers Series Fund, and the Bell Fund. David Frazee and Rachel Talalay serve as co-directors; Mackenzie Donaldson, Andrew Miller, and Carrie-Anne Moss are executive producers; and Charles Cooper is producer.

The series is distributed internationally by Sphere Abacus, a Bell Media company, and was exclusively acquired by AMC Global Media for AMC+ in the United States.

title: Martin Sheen & Jana Kramer Faith Film ‘The One’ Gets U.S. Release & Launch Date
text:
EXCLUSIVE : Holiday faith drama The One , starring screen legend Martin Sheen ( The West Wing ) and actress-singer Jana Kramer ( One Tree Hill ), has been picked up for U.S. distribution by Hawk Hill Pictures, which will release the movie in theaters nationwide on November 5.

The release date coincides with National Homeless Youth Awareness Month, bringing attention to the film’s story of an 18-year-old navigating homelessness after aging out of the Chicago foster system.

Filmed in Oklahoma with incentives from The Film in Oklahoma Act, pic is directed by Lisa Arnold and produced by Erin Elizabeth Cook (who also co-stars), and Adam Ropp. Also starring are Olivia Sanabia Nick Zano, and Indigenous musician and actor Noah Redclay. The movie also marks the feature-film debut of Ashlyn Tomlin, daughter of singer Chris Tomlin. Related Stories News Charlie & Martin Sheen To Star As Father & Son In Comedy Series 'Happy Jack' For AMC Agencies Martin Sheen Signs With Paradigm

The synopsis reads: “When 18-year-old Hawk ages out of the Chicago foster system, he sets out to see the lighting of the country’s largest Christmas tree, the One. Carrying only his guitar, he faces potential homelessness, undiagnosed PTSD, and a harsh winter alone until he crosses paths with Jefferson, a mysterious traveler, and Alexis, a runaway teenager grieving the loss of her twin sister. Together, they embark on an unexpected journey of faith, hope and healing.” Watch on Deadline

“From the moment we encountered this story, we were captivated,” said Jen Katzfey, President of Hawk Hill Pictures. “It is inspiring, beautifully acted, and shines an important light on a subject that deserves to be seen and heard. We couldn’t be more thrilled to bring this powerful film exclusively to theaters and give audiences the opportunity to experience it on the big screen.”

In conjunction with the movie’s release, the filmmakers have partnered with For Others, the nonprofit founded by Tomlin and his wife, that works to raise awareness of the child welfare crisis in America.

title: ‘Harry Potter’ TV Series Due To Hit HBO Christmas 2026: Everything We Know About The Cast, Who’s Creating It, What J.K. Rowling Says & More
text:
There will be another season of HBO Max ‘s Harry Potter TV series.

The new Harry, Ron and Hermione have received their Hogwarts admission letters, as have the newest additions — four out of Ron’s six siblings . Since those magical owl deliveries, the Ginny Weasley role will be recast for Season 2 due to Gracie Cochrane’s departure from the series “due to unforeseen circumstances.”

RELATED: Harry Potter TV Series Actors: Photos Of Who’s Playing Harry, Ron & Hermione Watch on Deadline

Dominic McLaughlin will portray The Boy Who Lived, Harry Potter himself. Alastair Stout will play Harry’s best friend Ronald Weasley, and Arabella Stanton will round out the classic trio of heroes as bookworm Hermione Granger, who matches the courage of the previous two Gryffindors.

Four months after Deadline revealed that Francesca Gardiner was one of three finalists to win the prize to reboot the classic kids franchise for the small screen, the Succession consulting producer for Seasons 3 and 4 won the showrunner gig . Gardiner beat Tom Moran and Kathleen Jordan to win the job. Mark Mylod, who worked with Gardiner on Succession will direct multiple episodes of the series in addition to executive producing.

RELATED: John Lithgow On Saying “Yes” To Playing Albus Dumbledore In HBO’s ‘Harry Potter’ Series: “I’m Afraid, But I’m Very Excited”

Chris Columbus, who directed the first two films in the franchise adapted from J.K. Rowlings best-selling books, Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone and Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets , approves of HBO’s television reboot, calling it a “spectacular idea.”

At its Max streaming event in April 2023, Warner Bros. Discovery confirmed a new era is coming for Harry Potter fans . The company announced a TV series based on all seven books about the boy wizard written by J.K. Rowling . On June 25, it was revealed that the series is moving to HBO in a rethink of WBD’s big-budget streaming strategy .

See below for the most current answers to the most important questions about the project.

Yes, the first teaser trailer was released March 25.

RELATED: ‘Harry Potter’ Trailer Gives Glimpse Of Sorting Ceremony, More Dumbledore & Snape In HBO Series

Another fuller trailer came out Sept. 2, after what has become known as return-to-Hogwarts day (Sept. 1). In it, viewers get glimpses of Janet McTeer’s Professor Minerva McGonagall, Jon Lithgow’s Dumbledore, Paapa Essiedu’s Snape and Nick Frost’s Hagrid. Harry’s Cloak of Invisibility is shown, as is the animated figures of Wizard’s Chess, the Mirror of Erised and the chamber hiding Fluffy the three-headed dog. Quidditch players also circle up on the pitch.

“This new Max Original series will dive deep into each of the iconic books that fans have continued to enjoy for all of these years,” said Casey Bloys , Chairman and CEO, HBO & Max Content about the project, which he also assured fans would be “a faithful adaptation.”

RELATED: The Story Behind Francesca Gardiner’s HBO Hire: Meet The Showrunner Tasked With Casting Another Spell On ‘Harry Potter’ Fans

Early reports had each season of the series focusing on one book in the Harry Potter book series, which consists of seven novels, but Bloys said the project would run for “10 consecutive years,” which would seem to defy the 1 season, 1 book assertion. For those who say Fantastic Beasts could be leveraged to provide 10 seasons over 10 years, WBD brass said specifically during the announcement that FB will not be a part of the series.

Whatever the case, Bloys promised that, as the company embarks on its new Harry Potter adventure, “We do so with the full care and craft of this franchise.”

Yes, HBO has renewed the series for a second season , elevating Jon Brown from writer on Season 1 to co-showrunner for Season 2 with Francesca Gardiner.

RELATED: Original Dumbledore Actor’s Son Doesn’t See Need For ‘Harry Potter’ TV Reboot: “I Don’t Understand”

Deadline broke the news that Kit Harrington would replace Nicholas Hoult as Defense Against the Dark Arts professor Gilderoy Lockhart in Season 2 of the series after reporting Hoult’s casting exclusively as well. Kenneth Branagh originated the somewhat aloof professor, who steps into the role after Professor Quirrell was revealed to be hosting the feeble Lord Voldemort on the back of his bald head. Little does Lockhart know what he’s getting into. For Harrington, the casting marks a reprising of his voice role in the Harry Potter: The Full-Cast Audio Editions released at the end of 2025.

Bonnie Hill ( Girl Troop versus Aliens ) will take over the role of Ginny Weasley come Season 2, and Lenny Rush ( Am I Being Unreasonable? ) will play loyal house-elf Dobby. Billy Barratt, who is the youngest International Emmy winner, will portray Tom Riddle , the younger version of Voldemort before he became He Who Shall Not Be Named.

Molly Hewitt-Richards will portray Moaning Myrtle, Rafe Spall will play patriarch Arthur Weasley, and Jasper Ambrose will appear Colin Creevey in the latest round of casting announcements.

Yes, cameras began rolling as of July 14, 2025. HBO had confirmed that the show would start shooting in the summer of 2025 at Leavesden. The April 2025 casting timeline supported this as well. Showrunner Francesca Gardiner and EP Mark Mylod made a surprise appearance at the Max Showcase in London to reveal the big step in production .

Season 2 is aiming to start production in the fall.

Succession duo Francesca Gardiner and Mark Mylod have signed up as its writer and director, respectively. Gardiner will serve as showrunner and executive producer, and Mylod will direct multiple episodes in addition to serving as executive producer.

Holly Waddington, who won an Oscar in her craft for Poor Things , serves as costume designer, Deadline reported exclusively . Killing Eve scribe Laura Neal has joined the writers room . Deadline exclusively profiled showrunner Francesca Gardiner with insight from her colleagues.

RELATED: ‘Harry Potter’ HBO Series Finds Its Creative Team In ‘Succession’ Duo Francesca Gardiner & Mark Mylod

Rowling was understood to be involved in this pitching process when the group of writing candidates pitched their takes on the IP.

Framestore VFX is in talks to recreate the magical world it brought to life in the eight movies adapted from J.K. Rowling’s seven books. Warner Bros. Discovery is also speaking to other companies about visual effects, but Framestore is in prime position to clinch a contract, we hear. A deal is not yet done.

Season 1, based on Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone , will release Christmas 2026 on HBO and HBO Max .

RELATED: ‘Harry Potter’ Alum Jessie Cave On Miriam Margolyes’ Take On Adult Fans: “I Really Don’t Like That She Said That”

At a Goldman Sachs conference in 2022, Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav pointed out the need for more Hogwarts magic explicitly. Ignoring the Harry-less Fantastic Beasts films, the CEO insisted the boy wizard presents a huge opportunity, claiming that the IP has been “underused” of late.

“We haven’t done anything with Harry Potter for more than a decade,” he said, before going on to note that when one examines the performance of Warner Bros. over the last 20 years without accounting for it’s big three — Potter , Lord of the Rings and DC — the company’s performance is “relatively flat.”

RELATED: J.K. Rowling Reveals How She Told ‘Harry Potter’ Star Alan Rickman About Character’s Big Secret

Zaslav called that type of big-ticket IP “one of the big differentiators of this company.” And he seems to be counting on it to make a big difference.

“When you put those franchises in, it’s the best-performing studio in the world. We need to deploy our best capital, and we need to do it with the best creative people in the world,” he said.

It will, of course, be on Max once the series is ready. The service has three price tiers: Basic with Ads, which goes for $10.99 a month or $109.99 a year; Standard will be priced at $18.49 a month, or $184.99 a year, and will allow two concurrent streams; and Premium which costs $22.99 a month, or $229.99 a year, and allows access to four concurrent streams.

RELATED: Miriam Margolyes Says Adult ‘Harry Potter’ Fans Worry Her: “They Should Be Over That By Now”

In addition, WBD’s other current epic literary adaptation, House of the Dragon , is available not only on the company’s streaming service, but also to cable subscribers on HBO. The Potter series will follow suit, according to execs. So if you have HBO via your cable provider, you’re all set.

If you’re in Canada, WBD has struck a multi-year licensing agreement with Crave for the likes of Harry Potter , Game of Thrones , the DC Universe and HBO content.

John Lithgow will play the beloved Hogwarts Headmaster Albus Dumbledore, previously portrayed in the films first by Richard Harris in The Sorcerer’s Stone and The Chamber of Secrets films and then by Michael Gambon in the rest of the movie installments.

A whopping 32,000 young actors auditioned for the lead roles of Harry, Hermione and Ron, Gardiner revealed at the end of 2024.

The choices of Dominic McLaughlin, Alastair Stout and Ronald Weasley as the trio were the result of a specific set of requirements.

“We are committed to inclusive, diverse casting,” the casting call noted at the bottom in language that has become an industry standard. “For every role, please submit qualified performers, without regard to ethnicity, sex, disability, race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by law unless otherwise specifically indicated.”

Warner Bros. wanted young actors, given that they’re proceeding through Rowling’s books in order. “The tricky part is the first two books, where the kids are on the younger end, around 11 or 12,” said Warner Bros. TV  Group Chairman Channing Dungey of the casting process.

Rory Wilmot has been cast as Neville Longbottom, Amos Kitson as Dudley Dursley, Louise Brealey as Madam Rolanda Hooch, and Anton Lesser as Garrick Ollivander.

RELATED: Daniel Radcliffe Was “Terrified” Of Alan Rickman In First Three ‘Harry Potter’ Films

Tristan and Gabriel Harland will portray Fred and George Weasley. Ruari Spooner will play Percy Weasley, and Gracie Cochrane will star as Ginny Weasley in Season 1. Cochrane will not reappear as the youngest Weasley sibling from Season 2 onwards.

Some big names were in the conversation earlier on to play major characters in the series with Sharon Horgan ( Bad Sisters ), Paapa Essiedu ( I May Destroy You ), Brett Goldstein ( Ted Lasso, Shrinking ) and Mark Strong among names that were circulating for McGonagall, Snape, Hagrid and Dumbledore. Deadline first reported that John Lithgow was nearing final talks for the role of Albus Dumbledore, the aloof yet powerful headmaster of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Lithgow confirmed the casting to Screen Rant .

More recently, Deadline broke the news that British actor-comedian Nick Frost was nearing a deal to play half-giant Rubeus Hagrid. Cryptically, on March 20 Frost posted to Instagram , “It’s happening, it’s actually happening.”

Janet McTeer will portray Professor Minerva McGonagal, the transfiguration teacher and head of Gryffindor house at Hogwarts, while Paapa Essiedu will portray potions professor and Slytherin house head, Severus Snape.

RELATED: ‘Harry Potter’ Director Chris Columbus Praises HBO’s Upcoming TV Reboot: “A Spectacular Idea”

A slew of new cast members includes Bertie Carvel who, as Deadline revealed exclusively , will be playing minister of magic Cornelius Fudge. Lox Pratt (Netflix’s Lord of the Flies ) is slated to play Draco Malfoy, with Johnny Flynn as his father Lucius Malfoy. In more family castings, Bel Powley is set as Petunia Dursley and Daniel Rigby as Vernon Dursley, Harry’s aunt and uncle. Additionally, Katherine Parkinson will play Ron’s mom, Molly Weasley.

Cast as Hogwarts students are Leo Earley as Seamus Finnigan, Alessia Leoni as Parvati Patil, and Sienna Moosah as Lavender Brown.

Responses about a potential return from veteran guest stars in the series ranged from willing to coy.

RELATED: ‘Harry Potter’ TV Series Actress Bel Powley “Strongly Disagrees” With J.K. Rowling’s Anti-Trans Views

Slow Horses star Gary Oldman told IndieWire at the red carpet for the 76th Emmys that he would be open to returning to the series, suggesting a portrayal of Dumbledore . The team behind the reboot has not approached him yet with any ideas. The actor also shared that he felt his original character, Sirius Black, was not present in enough of the films.

At the red carpet premiere for Season 3 of HBO’s original series The White Lotus , star Jason Isaacs joked that he hopes to return in the role of Hermione Granger.

Jason Isaacs on Max’s upcoming ‘Harry Potter’ series : “I’m hoping to come back as Hermione” pic.twitter.com/g2dUQcpPjL

As for a return of any of the film franchise’s stars — like Daniel Radcliffe, Emma Watson or Rupert Grint — never say never. It would certainly be a PR boost for the series and, while new actors have been cast in the primary roles, there are always flashforwards or the currently en vogue multiverse plot ploy that could create space for more familiar faces in the series.

But Daniel Radcliffe has said he is fine with sitting on the sidelines.

“My understanding is that they’re trying to very much start fresh and I’m sure whoever is making them will want to make their own mark on it and probably not want to have to figure out how to get old Harry to cameo in this somewhere,” Radcliffe told ComicBook.com . “So I’m definitely not seeking it out in any way. But I do wish them, obviously, all the luck in the world and I’m very excited to have that torch passed. But I don’t think it needs me to physically pass it.”

RELATED: HBO Circling Paapa Essiedu For Severus Snape Role In ‘Harry Potter’ TV Show

Radcliffe echoed these thoughts in an interview with E! News saying he is “excited to watch as an audience member.”

When asked if he would be in it, he said “I don’t think so, I think they very wisely want to [have] a clean break.”

Another longtime Potter player who likely won’t be involved is David Yates, who directed the last four movies, Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix (2007), Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (2009) and Deathly Hallows Part One and Two (2010 and 2011). In addition, Yates took on the Potter spinoff Fantastic Beasts trilogy. He says there has been no conversation about his involvement with the series, and it sounds like he’s ok with that.

“Huge affection and a lovely group of people I worked with,” Yates told Deadline . “But we haven’t had a conversation since we finished it.”

“It’s been about ‘Let’s just park it, and be done for a while,'” he said of the Potter franchise.

“Never say never, I would say, but I’m excited about moving on,” he said.

Your Hogwarts letter is here. Max has ordered the first ever #HarryPotter scripted television series, a faithful adaptation of the iconic books. #StreamOnMax pic.twitter.com/3CgEHLYhch

Yes. A deal for J.K. Rowling’s involvement in the series had been the biggest hurdle in its path to the screen: The author has creative control over any interpretation of her work. That agreement was finalized in 2023.

Rowling and longtime collaborators Neil Blair and Ruth Kenley-Letts are exec producing, so she is expected to be involved in the decision-making on the series. David Heyman, who developed the films, was in talks to do the same. Rowling’s Brontë Film and TV is producing with Warner Bros. Television. Brontë Film and TV was founded by Rowling and her literary agent, Neil Blair, in 2012.

“Max’s commitment to preserving the integrity of my books is important to me, and I’m looking forward to being part of this new adaptation which will allow for a degree of depth and detail only afforded by a long form television series,” said Rowling in a statement.

When asked by a fan if she’s writing the series, Rowling replied , “No, but I’ve worked closely with the extremely talented writers.”

RELATED: ‘Harry Potter’ Star Ralph Fiennes Says He “Would Be All In Favor” Of Cillian Murphy To Take Over Voldemort Role In HBO Series

Since Warners launched its streaming service, there’s always been a goal to reinterpret Warners’ biggest franchise for streaming. Warner Bros Discovery CEO David Zaslav, taking the reigns after the merger last year, met with Rowling several times in the UK. He’s even spoken up in support of the author, who has been involved in an ongoing controversy over her comments on transgender issues . Asked about the streaming event about those controversies, Bloys demurred.

“No, I don’t think this is the forum [to discuss that],” he said. “That’s a very online conversation, very nuanced and complicated and not something we’re going to get into.”

“Our priority is what’s on the screen,” Bloys continued. “Obviously, the Harry Potter story is incredibly affirmative and positive and about love and self-acceptance. That’s our priority — what’s on screen.”

As for how close the author will be to the series, Bloys said, “[Rowling] will be involved. She’s an executive producer on the show. Her insights are going to be helpful on that.”

Rowling has said she approves of the scripts she’s seen.

“I read the first two episodes of the forthcoming HBO Harry Potter series and they are SO, SO, SO GOOD!” she wrote on X .

The author’s involvement could prove a hurdle to having the principals from the films involved in the series. Relations between Rowling, Radcliffe and Emma Watson can’t be great, given the author recently said she was “bloody angry” over stances taken by trans rights activists, which she sees being in opposition to women’s rights.

Rowling claimed that “thousands are complicit, not just medics, but the celebrity mouthpieces, unquestioning media and cynical corporations.” Asked specifically whether she would forgive Radcliffe and Watson for their unabashed pro-trans rights stance on the issue Rowling replied, “Celebs who cosied up to a movement intent on eroding women’s hard-won rights and who used their platforms to cheer on the transitioning of minors can save their apologies.”

Bloys was clear, however, that WBD wasn’t entirely dependent on Rowling for the project.

“The TV show is new and we’re excited about that. But, remember, we’ve been in the Potter business for 20 years. This is not a new decision for us, we’re very comfortable being in the Potter business.”

RELATED: ‘Harry Potter’ Series To Begin Shooting Over The Summer At Leavesden; Showrunner Reveals 32,000 Kids Auditioned For Lead Roles

At his most recent appearance speaking on the show, Bloys said “we are totally comfortable with” working alongside the author of the source material. He pointed out that the company had “huge success” with last year’s Hogwarts video game.

He said he would rather “do what the creatives want to do” than “listen to fan conversation.”

“You know we make shows at this scale with House of the Dragon , Game of Thrones ,” said Bloys. “I imagine will be that scale or higher. The shorter answer is whatever it takes to make a quality show.”

Per Deadline reporting, House of the Dragon cost nearly $200 million and was the subject of HBO’s biggest marketing campaign ever, valued at over $100M in media spend (that’s a combo of ad spot value and hard cash shelled out). So fans can expect a similar outlay for the Potter series “or higher,” according to HBO/Max boss Bloys.

“We’re free to do anything we want,” Zaslav has said, before hedging a bit. “Some areas we need to do with J.K., other areas we have the full ability to go forward. This is a full deployment on Max of Harry Potter. We can still develop other properties.”

It’s unclear where those boundaries lie, but it is clear that Warner Bros. Discovery would like more Potter. Since he took control of the merged company, Zaslav has stressed multiple times his focus on franchises, with mining the Harry Potter IP identified as a top priority.

Deadline understands that there may also be an opportunity for more than one of the above-mentioned writers to be involved and that Max is open to the possibility of developing more than one idea based on Harry Potter.

One such effort, Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking has already been a ratings success, proving yet again there is still an appetite for the IP.

Max and its then-parent company WarnerMedia started exploring a potential Harry Potter TV series a couple of years ago. At the time, Warner Bros. appointed Kids, Young Adult and Classics president Tom Ascheim to manage the Wizarding World and Potter franchises, which include theme parks, tours and the $9.1 billion-grossing theatrical library that spans the Harry Potter and spinoff Fantastic Beasts titles. Under that setup, Ascheim became WarnerMedia’s senior rep in its relationship with Rowling and her representatives, and exploratory conversations for a Max series got underway.

After the Discovery acquisition was completed a year ago, that unit was disbanded and Ascheim exited the company . However, the importance of the Harry Potter IP has only grown post-merger.

Zaslav spoke about his family’s own personal connection to the series.

“My wife and I, we read (the Harry Potter books) to each of our three kids,” said Zaslav, going off script at the Max announcement. “It’s really moving, for ten consecutive years, people will see Harry Potter on HBO; I mean it’s really something.”

title: Adam Driver & Anne Hathaway Pic ‘Alone At Dawn’ From Amazon MGM Studios & Imagine To Roll Out At Christmas 2027
text:
EXCLUSIVE: Amazon MGM Studios and Imagine Entertainment ‘s Ron Howard directed true-life film Alone at Dawn will begin a platform release on December 25, 2027, before expanding on January 7 and getting a wide break over the MLK weekend, January 14-17.

Deadline first told you about the project. Oscar winner Anne Hathaway , 2x Oscar nominee Adam Driver and newly minted Emmy winner Betty Gilpin star in the feature take on Dan Schilling and Lori Longfritz’s book about Air Force combat controller John Chapman. Years after he fought to the death to save his fellow soldiers, an intelligence officer strives to prove his valor — leading an investigation that ultimately would secure the Medal of Honor for Chapman.

The year-end holiday corridor historically has been a strong launch window for prestige, adult-skewing action-dramas, including such films as American Sniper, Lone Survivor and 1917 . We hear that Alone at Dawn is still being finished, and next Christmas is the prime time. Watch on Deadline

Michael Russell Gunn adapted Schilling and Longfritz’s 2019 book. Producers are Imagine’s Brian Grazer, Howard, Jeb Brody and Allan Mandelbaum; Hideaway Entertainment’s Jonathan Gray, as well as Matthew Rhodes, Ron West, Kristy Grisham, William M. Connor and Patrick Newall. Thruline Entertainment is producing the action drama feature as well.

Amazon MGM Studios fired up the year with the first tentpole, that being the Ryan Gosling-starring Project Hail Mary, which grossed over $685M WW. title: ‘The Kardashians’ Sets Season 8 Release Date, Unveils Trailer Which Reveals Kim In A Hospital Bed & More
text:
We’re getting the first extended look at Season 8 of The Kardashians ahead of its fall return. The new season premieres Thursday, October 8 on Hulu, Hulu+ for bundle subscribers in the U.S. and Disney+ internationally.

The official trailer opens with a question posed to Kris. “How are your daughters getting along this season?”, to which a hesitant Kris replies. “Well, it’s been a week.”

And what a week it was.

Of course, the conversation turns to dating. “Have you dated anyone privately?”, Kim is asked. “Let me just say this: I can’t control myself.” We also see Khloe in a playful exchange with Scott Dissick, asking if they’re having a baby together.

Footage later jumps to Kim in a hospital bed as she reveals she has esophagitis. Watch on Deadline
